verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly state Fedora Workstation includes Clocks, Weather and Maps utilities out of the box, and calendar integration is available via online accounts (though calendar app itself isn't separately confirmed). No independent/hands-on corroboration of these specific apps working well, and no mention of a bundled calendar app by name. Missing for 10: independent verification that Clocks/Weather/Maps work reliably out of the box, explicit confirmation of a bundled Calendar app, and any hands-on switcher testimonial about these specific utilities.
